behavior: Before payment the owner edits the reference, note and due date, and the payer sees each change under Updates on the pay page
acceptance: PUT details also takes reference, note and dueDate; a change to them needs every option open, the checkout open and no transfer seen, else 409 invoice_not_editable; a new due date lies between today and the day the checkout closes
Each change writes one invoice.edited row; a due date's row has from and to; the database refuses these changes once money was seen or the invoice is not open
The Edit dialog has the three fields under Before payment, disabled with the reason once money arrived or the checkout closed
Both invoice reads return updates (time, field, from, to) and the pay page lists them as Updates; History shows the due date's from and to
openapi.yaml, api.md, R-128 and DESIGN.md match; unit, lint and typecheck pass
